info.title: craftsman
info.description: A .NET scaffolding tool to help you stop worrying about boilerplate and focus on your business logic. Go to https://wrapt.dev for the full documentation.

commands.name: authserver
commands.description:
Adds a Duende based auth server project to your solution using a formatted yaml
or json file.

commands.name: bc
commands.description:
Scaffolds a new bounded context for a Wrapt domain project based on a given
template file in a json or yaml format.

commands.name: bus
commands.description:
Adds a message bus to your web api and a messages directory to your shared
kernel using a formatted yaml or json file. A template file is optional.

commands.name: consumer
commands.description:
Add a receive endpoint and register it with MassTransit using a formatted yaml
or json file.

commands.name: entity
commands.description:
Add one or more new entities to your Wrapt project using a formatted yaml or
json file.

commands.name: feature
commands.description: Scaffolds out a new feature using CLI prompts.

commands.name: message
commands.description:
Adds one or more messages to your Shared Kernel project using a formatted yaml
or json file.

commands.name: entity
commands.description:
Adds basic entity scaffolding including apis, forms, and routes to a NextJS
project using a formatted yaml or json file.

commands.name: producer
commands.description:
Adds a distinct feature that produces a message and registers it with
MassTransit using a formatted yaml or json file.

commands.name: domain
commands.description: Scaffolds a project based on a given template file in a json or yaml format.

commands.name: example
commands.description: Scaffolds out an example project via CLI prompts into the current directory.

commands.name: producer
commands.description:
Register a producer with MassTransit using CLI prompts. This is especially
useful for adding a new publish action to an existing feature (e.g.
EntityCreated).
